name: cover-cream-orange-knowledge-poster-with-docs
displayName: Cream Orange Knowledge Poster With Docs
description: Create a self-contained article cover plus inline visual package in the cream-orange knowledge family from pasted article text, Markdown files, or plain-text files. Defaults to a brief with 1 cover and 3 inline visuals; supports 1-5 inline visuals. DOCX and PDF are not supported.
